aoi.label: Mỹ Thành, Đồng Tháp (user label; coordinate not independently surveyed)

primary_metric: MAE in target units; equally weighted validation months
old_exposed_period: 2015-2025: v1 EDA/test exposed, used for reproducibility and optional SMAP ablation only, never new blind test
availability_policy: Completed calendar months only; conservative one extra month latency buffer. Historical product vintage unavailable: retrospective hindcast, not operational skill proof.
selection: lowest mean development MAE; within 2% prefer lower-complexity baseline; test cannot change candidate
interval: 80% absolute residual empirical band from development rolling errors; evaluate coverage/width, no guaranteed dependent-time coverage
stop: Evaluate baseline, v1 reproduction, HGB raw/expanded/log-target, ridge anomalies, ExtraTrees, bias correction and blend. Stop after preregistered search plus development error analysis when marginal gain <2% or budget reached. No test-driven tuning.
independence_warning: New historical 2012-2014 labels were not in original DATA v1. Final evaluation is retrospective, single AOI, no spatial/generalization or field-rain accuracy claim. Test integrity also requires immutable selection record.
primary_scope: monthly climate estimates, not daily weather forecasts or exact irrigation requirements
